Interactions in the survival part of a joint model with unknown elements

Source: R/get_model_info.R
check_jm_unknown_interactions.Rd

An interaction term is only recognised as such (in Mlist$interactions) when all its elements are columns of the design matrices. In the time-varying part of the linear predictor of the survival part of a joint model, the value of an interaction term is the product of its elements (see paste_jm_interaction()), so that an interaction with an element that is not a column is not possible. This happens

  • for an interaction with a function of the time variable (e.g., chol:ns(day, df = 3)) without the main effect of this function: as a workaround, the function can be added to the data with the argument auxvars (this does not change the models for incomplete covariates, because they already contain the time variable);

  • for an interaction of a factor with a variable without the main effect of that variable (e.g., sex + sex:day): R (model.matrix()) then codes the interaction with all categories of the factor, also the reference category (sexmale:day and sexfemale:day), which is not a column of the design matrix. Together, these terms contain a main effect of the other variable, which, for the time variable or a function of it, cannot (or hardly) be distinguished from the baseline hazard.

Usage

check_jm_unknown_interactions(lp_cols, interactions, design_cols, refs,
  timevar)

Arguments

lp_cols

named integer vector: the columns of M_lvlone in the linear predictor of the survival model (names are the column names).

interactions

list of interaction terms, as in Mlist$interactions (output of match_interaction()).

design_cols

character vector: the names of all columns of the design matrices.

refs

list of reference category information (Mlist$refs).

timevar

name of the time variable.

Value

NULL, invisibly; called for the error.

Details

Stops with an informative error if there is such an interaction.
